title: Call site incompatible with new signature
rationale: A caller still uses the old calling convention. In Python this raises TypeError at call time; in TypeScript it fails compilation.

title: Removed symbol is still referenced
rationale: Code that imports or calls a removed or renamed symbol fails at import or call time.

title: Breaking signature change
rationale: The signature changed incompatibly. No incompatible caller was found in the analysed code, but callers outside it (other services, packages, scripts) would break.

title: Function became async but callers do not await it
rationale: Calling an async function without awaiting it returns a coroutine/promise instead of the value, silently changing behaviour.

title: Default argument value changed
rationale: Callers that omit the argument now receive different behaviour without any code change on their side.

title: Return type annotation changed
rationale: Callers may depend on the previous return type.

title: Public symbol removed
rationale: A public symbol was removed. No internal references remain, but external consumers may rely on it.

title: Syntax error introduced
rationale: The changed file no longer parses. It will fail at import/compile time.

title: Dynamic code execution
rationale: eval/exec/new Function execute strings as code; attacker-influenced input leads to code injection.

title: Unsafe HTML sink
rationale: Assigning untrusted strings to HTML sinks enables cross-site scripting.

title: Shell command built from dynamic input
rationale: Passing data to a shell enables command injection.

title: Unsafe deserialisation
rationale: pickle and yaml.load can construct arbitrary objects (and run code) from untrusted data.

title: TLS certificate verification disabled
rationale: Disabling certificate checks allows man-in-the-middle interception.

title: SQL built from string formatting
rationale: Interpolating values into SQL text enables SQL injection; use parameterised queries.

title: Hard-coded secret
rationale: Credentials committed to source control are exposed to everyone with repository access and persist in history after removal; they must be rotated.

title: Environment file committed
rationale: Environment files usually hold deployment secrets and should not be committed.

title: Exception silently swallowed
rationale: An empty or bare handler hides failures, turning errors into silent data corruption or missing work.

title: Error handling removed
rationale: A try/except (try/catch) block was removed from a modified function; failures that were handled now propagate to callers.

title: Async callback passed to forEach
rationale: Array.prototype.forEach ignores returned promises: iterations run concurrently and errors are unhandled.

title: Blocking call inside async function
rationale: A blocking call inside a coroutine stalls the event loop and every concurrent request.

title: Debug artifact left in code
rationale: Debug statements leak data to logs or pause execution in production.

title: Type checking suppressed
rationale: Suppressing the type checker hides the class of errors the compiler would otherwise catch.

title: Risky configuration value
rationale: Debug mode or wildcard CORS in application configuration weakens production security.

title: No related tests found for changed code
rationale: No test in the snapshot imports and references the changed symbol, so a regression may go undetected. Tests that exercise it indirectly are not detected.

title: Test disabled
rationale: A skip marker removes the test from the suite; the behaviour it covered is no longer verified.

title: Focused test committed
rationale: .only restricts the runner to the focused test(s); every other test in the file stops running in CI.

title: Assertions removed from test
rationale: Fewer assertions means the test verifies less behaviour than before.

title: Tests deleted
rationale: Deleted tests reduce regression protection; confirm the behaviour they covered is gone or re-tested.

title: Changed lines not covered by tests
rationale: The uploaded coverage report marks these changed executable lines as never executed by the test suite.

title: Changed file absent from coverage report
rationale: The coverage report has no data for this changed source file; it may not be imported by any test.

title: Destructive schema migration
rationale: Dropping or rewriting tables/columns destroys data and breaks code still reading it during a rolling deploy.

title: Dropped column still referenced in code
rationale: Application code still references a column this migration removes or renames.

title: Major version change of a dependency
rationale: Major releases commonly contain breaking API changes.

title: New dependency added
rationale: New third-party code enters the supply chain and should be reviewed for maintenance and licence.

title: Dependency removed
rationale: Code that still imports a removed dependency fails at import time.

title: Version constraint loosened
rationale: A looser constraint lets future installs pull untested versions.

title: Condition logic changed
rationale: A comparison/boolean operator or negation changed. Boundary behaviour differs, which is a classic source of off-by-one and inverted-condition bugs.

title: Boundary constant changed
rationale: A numeric constant in a condition changed, moving a threshold.

title: Complexity increased
rationale: Higher cyclomatic complexity means more paths to test and more room for untested edge cases.

title: Prompt-injection text in change
rationale: Text addressed to AI reviewers attempts to manipulate automated review. ChangeGuard neutralises it before any model sees the code, and AI output cannot remove deterministic findings.

title: Ruff invalid-syntax
rationale: The file no longer parses.

title: Ruff F821
rationale: Undefined name: raises NameError when the line executes.

title: Ruff F823
rationale: Local variable referenced before assignment: raises UnboundLocalError.

title: Ruff F811
rationale: Redefinition of an unused name shadows the earlier definition.

title: Ruff F632
rationale: `is` comparison with a literal depends on interning; use ==.

title: Ruff F601
rationale: Dictionary key repeated; the earlier value is silently discarded.

title: Ruff F704
rationale: yield outside a function is a SyntaxError.

title: Ruff F706
rationale: return outside a function is a SyntaxError.

title: Ruff F822
rationale: Name listed in __all__ is not defined.

title: Ruff B006
rationale: Mutable default argument is shared between calls.

title: Ruff B008
rationale: Function call in default argument runs once at definition time.

title: Ruff B012
rationale: return/break/continue in finally swallows in-flight exceptions.

title: Ruff B015
rationale: Comparison result is discarded; this was probably meant to be an assert.

title: Ruff B018
rationale: Useless expression has no effect.

title: Ruff B020
rationale: Loop variable overrides the iterable it iterates.

title: Ruff B023
rationale: Closure captures the loop variable by reference (late binding).

title: Ruff B904
rationale: Exception re-raised without `from`, losing the original cause.

title: Ruff B011
rationale: `assert False` is removed under python -O.

title: Ruff E722
rationale: Bare except also catches SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt.

title: Ruff BLE001
rationale: Blind `except Exception` hides unexpected failures.

title: Ruff S110
rationale: try/except/pass silently swallows errors.

title: Ruff S102
rationale: exec() runs arbitrary code.

title: Ruff S307
rationale: eval() runs arbitrary code; use ast.literal_eval for literals.

title: Ruff S301
rationale: pickle deserialisation of untrusted data executes arbitrary code.

title: Ruff S506
rationale: yaml.load without SafeLoader can instantiate arbitrary objects.

title: Ruff S602
rationale: subprocess with shell=True enables command injection.

title: Ruff S604
rationale: Function call with shell=True enables command injection.

title: Ruff S605
rationale: Starting a process with a shell enables command injection.

title: Ruff S608
rationale: SQL built with string formatting enables SQL injection.

title: Ruff S105
rationale: Hard-coded password string.

title: Ruff S106
rationale: Hard-coded password passed as an argument.

title: Ruff S107
rationale: Hard-coded password default argument.

title: Ruff S501
rationale: TLS certificate verification disabled (verify=False).

title: Ruff S323
rationale: Unverified SSL context disables certificate checks.

title: Ruff S324
rationale: Insecure hash function (MD5/SHA1) used.

title: Ruff S311
rationale: Non-cryptographic random generator used.

title: Ruff S113
rationale: HTTP request without a timeout can hang indefinitely.

title: Ruff S201
rationale: Flask debug mode exposes an interactive debugger.

title: Ruff S701
rationale: Jinja2 autoescape disabled enables XSS.

title: Ruff S103
rationale: Overly permissive file permissions.

title: Ruff S202
rationale: tarfile.extractall without filtering allows path traversal.

title: Ruff S104
rationale: Binding to all interfaces exposes the service.

title: Ruff ASYNC210
rationale: Blocking HTTP call inside async function stalls the event loop.

title: Ruff ASYNC220
rationale: Blocking subprocess call inside async function.

title: Ruff ASYNC221
rationale: Blocking subprocess call inside async function.

title: Ruff ASYNC230
rationale: Blocking file I/O inside async function.

title: Ruff ASYNC251
rationale: time.sleep inside async function blocks the event loop.

title: Ruff RUF006
rationale: Task created without keeping a reference may be garbage-collected.

title: Ruff T100
rationale: Debugger breakpoint left in code pauses execution.

title: Ruff T201
rationale: print() left in non-test code.

title: Ruff PLE1142
rationale: await outside async function is a SyntaxError.
